director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj hum ek poore ke barabar hisse karke bhinn banayenge. Toh shuru karte hain?
pata nahi

Chalo, main batati hoon. Ghar mein roti barabar baanti jaati hai; har hisse ka naam hota hai. Yeh roti 4 barabar hisson mein bati hai, aur rang wala hissa 1/4 hai. Barabar hisson mein se aisa ek hissa fractional unit kehlata hai. Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
1/4 mein neeche wala 4 batata hai ki roti kitne barabar hisson mein bati. Ab bagal wali roti ke hisse gino. 8 barabar hisson wali roti ka ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao

Achha, ab Hindi mein bolti hoon. Socho chaar dost yeh roti barabar baant-te hain. Har dost ke haath chaar barabar hisson mein se ek aata hai, jaise yeh rang wala hissa: roti ka 1/4. Aise ek hisse ko fractional unit kehte hain. Doosri roti ke 8 hisse hain, sab ek jitne bade. Unmein se ek hisse ko kya naam doge?
director.card: Doosri roti ke 8 hisse hain, sab ek jitne bade. Unmein se ek hisse ko kya naam doge?

seams.form: Achha, ab Hindi mein bolti hoon.

director.text: ek-aathvaan

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki roti ke 8 barabar hisse, aur yeh unmein se ek. Do pattiyan dekho, dono ke 3 hisse. A ke teeno hisse barabar hain, toh har hissa 1/3 hai. B ke hisse chhote-bade hain, toh unhe gin kar 1/3 nahi keh sakte. Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?
director.card: Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?

director.text: pata nahi

Pehle socho, 15 cm ki patti teen barabar hisson mein kaatte toh har hissa kitna lamba hota. Phir dekho kaunsa hissa utna lamba hai. 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hisson wali 15 cm ki patti mein, kaunsa hissa 1/3 hai?
director.card: Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?

director.text: the 5 cm piece

Bilkul sahi. Patti ke teen barabar hisse 5-5 cm ke hote. Ab do ribbon lo: P 20 cm ki, Q 12 cm ki. P ka 1/2 10 cm hai, aur Q ka 1/2 6 cm. Naam ek hai, 1/2, par poora alag hai, isliye lambai alag hai. Ab dono ribbon ka 1/4 lo. P ka 1/4, Q ke 1/4 se kitne cm lamba hai?
director.card: Ab dono ribbon ka 1/4 lo. P ka 1/4, Q ke 1/4 se kitne cm lamba hai?

director.text: Haan, bilkul theek: P ka 1/4 5 cm, Q ka sirf 3 cm. Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain. Dadi ne 30 cm lamba ganna barabar hisson mein kaata, aur har hissa 6 cm ka hai. Ab dekhna hai ki ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai. Ganna kitne barabar hisson mein bata, yeh kis hisaab se nikaaloge?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain.

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Yahan ganna ek scale par hai, 0 se 30 cm tak, aur 6 cm par ek nishaan: ek hissa itna lamba hai. 30 cm ke ganne mein 6 cm ke kitne hisse hain, yeh jaanne ke liye kaunsa hisaab karoge?
pata nahi
Har hissa 6 cm ka hai aur poora ganna 30 cm. Socho, 6 cm ke hisse ek ke baad ek rakhte jao toh 30 cm tak kitne aayenge, aur yeh kis hisaab se niklega. Ab tum batao.
haan
Ab phir se socho, jawab kya hoga?
pata nahi, aap batao

Hisson ki ginti ke liye 30 ko 6 se bhaag denge, kyunki dekhna hai ki 30 cm mein 6 cm kitni baar aata hai. Dhyaan rakhna, fractional unit ke neeche hisse ki lambai 6 nahi aati; neeche woh ginti aati hai ki ganna kitne barabar hisson mein bata. Tumhari baari: 6 cm wala ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: 6 cm wala ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: mujhe nahi pata
Socho, 30 cm mein 6 cm kitni baar aata hai: utne hi barabar hisse hain, aur wahi ginti neeche aati hai. Chalo, ab tumhari baari.
director.card: Tumhari baari: 6 cm wala ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: mujhe khud try karne do
Haan, pehle tum try karo.
director.card: Tumhari baari: 6 cm wala ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: 1/6 sahi nahi hai. 6 toh ek hisse ki lambai hai, hisson ki ginti nahi; gino ki 30 cm mein 6 cm wale kitne hisse aate hain. 30 cm ke ganne ka 6 cm wala ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: 6 cm wala ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: Nahi, 1/6 theek nahi. Ek chhoti cheez se socho: 10 cm ki pencil 5 cm ke hisson mein kaato toh 2 hisse bante hain, aur ek hissa uska 1/2 hai. Ganne ke saath bhi aisa hi karna hai. Tumhari baari: 6 cm wala ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: 6 cm wala ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: one fifth

Haan, sahi hai. Toh poora jawab: ek hissa poore ganne ka 1/5 hai, kyunki 30 ÷ 6 = 5, toh neeche 5 aata hai, 6 nahi. Ab ek sawaal tum akele karo. 16 cm lambi chocolate toot kar 6, 2, 6 aur 2 cm ke hisson mein bat gayi. Inmein se kitne hisse poori chocolate ka 1/4 hain?
director.card: 16 cm lambi chocolate toot kar 6, 2, 6 aur 2 cm ke hisson mein bat gayi. Inmein se kitne hisse poori chocolate ka 1/4 hain?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal tum akele karo.

director.text: 4 sahi nahi hai. Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Dono pattiyon ke teen hisse, par barabar sirf pehli ke. Koi hissa 1/3 tab hai, jab uske jaise teen hisse milkar poori patti banayein. 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?
director.card: 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?

seams.form: Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain.

director.text: 3 se baat nahi bani. Teen hisse gin lene se har hissa 1/3 nahi banta; 1/3 sirf woh hissa hai jo 24 cm ko teen barabar hisson mein kaatne par bane hisse jitna lamba ho. 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hisson wali 24 cm ki ribbon mein, kitne hisse 1/3 hain?
director.card: 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?

director.text: 3 sahi nahi hai. Pehle socho, 24 cm ke teen barabar hisse kitne lambe hote. Phir har hisse ko usse milao. Jo socha hai, woh bol do.
director.card: 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?

seams.form: Jo socha hai, woh bol do.

director.text: Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Teen dost ek chocolate baantein: ek ko aadhi mile, aur do ko 1/4-1/4. Kisi ka bhi hissa 1/3 nahi, kyunki 1/3 toh teen barabar hisson mein se ek hota hai. 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?
director.card: 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?

director.text: Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. 1/3 matlab poore ke teen barabar hisson mein se ek. Chhote-bade hisse gin kar yeh naam nahi milta; har hisse ki lambai barabar wale hisse se milao. 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hisson wali 24 cm ki ribbon mein, kitne hisse 1/3 hain?
director.card: 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?

director.text: sirf ek hissa

Haan, sahi hai. 24 cm ka 1/3 24 ÷ 3 = 8 cm hai, aur 8 cm ka hissa sirf 1 hai. Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain. 16 cm lambi chocolate toot kar 6, 2, 6 aur 2 cm ke hisson mein bat gayi. Inmein se kitne hisse poori chocolate ka 1/4 hain?
director.card: 16 cm lambi chocolate toot kar 6, 2, 6 aur 2 cm ke hisson mein bat gayi. Inmein se kitne hisse poori chocolate ka 1/4 hain?

seams.form: Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain.

director.text: 0 hai na

Bilkul sahi: 16 cm ka 1/4 16 ÷ 4 = 4 cm hota, aur koi bhi hissa 4 cm ka nahi, toh 0 hisse. Ek ribbon 60 cm ki hai aur doosri 30 cm ki. Rahul ne pehli ka 1/3 liya, aur Sana ne doosri ka 1/2. Dono ke hisson mein kitne cm ka fark hai?
director.card: Ek ribbon 60 cm ki hai aur doosri 30 cm ki. Rahul ne pehli ka 1/3 liya, aur Sana ne doosri ka 1/2. Dono ke hisson mein kitne cm ka fark hai?

director.text: paanch cm

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki Rahul ka hissa 60 ÷ 3 = 20 cm, Sana ka 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm; 20 − 15 = 5. Ab ek hi poore ko kabhi kam, kabhi zyada barabar hisson mein baantenge, aur dekhenge ki ek hissa kaise badalta hai. Yahan tak saaf hai?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
sixer

Wah, sixer! Toh tumhara favourite yahi hai. Achha, ab wapas apne kaam par. Yeh do pattiyan bilkul ek jaisi hain. Pehli 3 barabar hisson mein bati hai, doosri 6 mein. 6 bada number hai, phir bhi 1/6 wala hissa 1/3 wale se chhota hai, kyunki wahi patti zyada hisson mein bati. Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?
director.card: Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?

seams.form: Achha, ab wapas apne kaam par.

j2.line: Wah, sixer! Toh tumhara favourite yahi hai.

director.text: 1 hisse

1 hisse sahi nahi hai. Wahi patti 3 ki jagah 6 barabar hisson mein bati, toh har hissa chhota ho gaya. Socho, 1/3 wala ek hissa kaat kar kitne 1/6 banenge. Kitne 1/6 hisse milkar ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?
director.card: Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?

director.text: 3 hisse

Nahi, 3 hisse theek nahi. Socho ek pizza 3 dost baantein aur bilkul waisa pizza 6 dost. 6 doston mein har ek ka hissa chhota hoga, kyunki pizza wahi hai. Board par bhi 1/6 wala hissa 1/3 wale se chhota hai. Ab tum batao.
director.card: Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?

director.text: two parts

Haan, sahi hai. Har 1/3 jitni jagah mein do 1/6. Do ek hi size ki chocolate 2 aur 4 doston mein bati: 4 doston wala hissa chhota hai. Jitne zyada dost, har dost ka hissa utna chhota. Ab teen ek hi size ki chocolate 3, 10 aur 5 doston mein bati. Inke hisson mein sabse chhota kaunsa hai: 1/3, 1/10 ya 1/5?
director.card: Ab teen ek hi size ki chocolate 3, 10 aur 5 doston mein bati. Inke hisson mein sabse chhota kaunsa hai: 1/3, 1/10 ya 1/5?

director.text: one tenth

Bilkul sahi: 10 doston wala hissa sabse chhota, phir 5 wala, phir 3 wala, toh 1/10 sabse chhota. Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum mil ke karenge. Ek patti barabar baantni hai. Hissa 1/3 se chhota par 1/6 se bada chahiye, aur dost 2, 4 ya 7 ho sakte hain. Dekhna hai patti kitne doston mein baantein. Har option ke liye pehle kya nikaaloge?

seams.form: Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum mil ke karenge.

director.text: mujhe nahi pata

Hissa 1/3 aur 1/6 se milana hai. Socho, har option mein kaunsi cheez nikaalni hogi jise in dono se milaa sako. 2, 4 ya 7 dost: in options ko 1/3 aur 1/6 se milane ke liye pehle har option mein kya pata karna hoga?
thak gayi, bye
Thak jaana theek hai; thoda aaram karo aur paani pi lo. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain.
